svg.title: Mathematics universe — foundations to decision
svg.desc: Profile-wide mathematics universe connecting analysis, algebra, differential geometry, probability, numerical mathematics, dynamics, networks, uncertainty, viability and decision structures. Connections indicate mathematical or computational relationships, not empirical causality.
